fact: The State accounting information system SIPCE (Oracle E-Business Suite, 3,000 users, 551 central government entities) has been operational since January 2020 and is interfaced with the GID, SIT tax, BADR customs and wadef@ujour payroll systems.
title: The New Moroccan Accountancy System
publisher: World Bank, 2021 IFMIS Capacity Building Program (A. Bouazzaoui)
